parties: Tube Investments of India Limited (acquirer) and Shanthi Gears Limited (target)
headline: Tube Investments of India discloses substantial acquisition in Shanthi Gears under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Tube Investments of India Limited has filed a disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4) and 31(5), indicating a substantial acquisition or change of control in Shanthi Gears Limited. The filing triggers mandatory public disclosure obligations under India's takeover framework.
implication: A Regulation 31(4)/(5) disclosure signals either that the acquirer has crossed a 25% threshold (if first-time acquisition) or is making an open offer; counsel must verify whether an open offer is mandated and the timing/pricing mechanics under SEBI(SAST) Regulations 2011.
detail: Tube Investments of India Limited, a diversified engineering and manufacturing conglomerate, has submitted a formal disclosure to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) and 31(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is a prerequisite step in the takeover process and signals either the crossing of a substantial shareholding threshold (typically 25%) or the commencement of a mandatory open offer. The exact shareholding position, consideration, and whether a full open offer will follow have not been disclosed in the available public summary. Shanthi Gears Limited is an engineering firm in the automotive components and industrial machinery space. The filing represents formal notice to the market of a material corporate control event.

framework.note: Mandatory disclosure requirements when a person acquires 25% or more of voting rights or control; triggers open offer obligation unless exempted.
Defines threshold events and control triggers; essential for determining if open offer is mandatory.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013, Section 192 (appointment of company secretary), Section 380 (acquisition by a company of its own shares)
